mapper.insert: INSERT INTO sys_user(id, username, password, nickname, phone, status, is_deleted) VALUES (#{id}, #{username}, #{password}, #{nickname}, #{phone}, #{status}, #{isDeleted})
mapper.update: UPDATE sys_user SET last_login_time = #{lastLoginTime} WHERE id = #{userId} AND status = 1 AND is_deleted = 0
UPDATE sys_user SET password = #{passwordHash} WHERE id = #{userId} AND status = 1 AND is_deleted = 0
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM sys_user WHERE username = #{username} AND status = 1 AND is_deleted != 1
SELECT id, username, password, nickname, avatar, phone, status, last_login_time, create_time, update_time, is_deleted FROM sys_user WHERE username = #{username} AND is_deleted = 0;
SELECT id, username, password, nickname, avatar, phone, status, last_login_time, create_time, update_time, is_deleted FROM sys_user WHERE id = #{userId} AND status = 1 AND is_deleted = 0;
